description: Check wallet configuration status — whether the wallet is set up, which chains are configured, and available accounts.
name: wallet_status

description: List blockchain chain readiness — which chains have a configured account and RPC provider.
name: wallet_chain_status

description: Prepare a cryptocurrency transfer. Returns a quote that must be confirmed before execution.
name: wallet_prepare_transfer

amountRaw.description: Transfer amount in the chain's smallest unit (e.g. wei for EVM)

assetSymbol.description: Asset symbol (e.g. ETH, USDC). Defaults to the native asset.

evmNetwork.description: Optional EVM network when chain='evm'. Defaults to ethereum_mainnet.

description: Check the on-chain lifecycle state (pending / confirmed / failed / not_found) of a transaction by hash.
name: wallet_tx_status

chain.description: Blockchain network whose transaction to check

evmNetwork.description: Optional EVM network when chain='evm'. Defaults to ethereum_mainnet.

hash.description: Transaction hash / signature / txid to query

description: Fetch the receipt of a broadcast transaction (success flag, fee, block, gas used) by hash.
name: wallet_tx_receipt

chain.description: Blockchain network whose transaction to fetch the receipt for

evmNetwork.description: Optional EVM network when chain='evm'. Defaults to ethereum_mainnet.

hash.description: Transaction hash / signature / txid to query

description: Look up the raw transaction payload by hash on the target chain.
name: wallet_lookup_tx

chain.description: Blockchain network whose transaction to look up

evmNetwork.description: Optional EVM network when chain='evm'. Defaults to ethereum_mainnet.

hash.description: Transaction hash / signature / txid to query

description: Prepare a single-chain crypto swap via deBridge. Returns a quote + quoteId to confirm with web3_swap_execute. For cross-chain swaps use web3_bridge_quote.
name: web3_swap_quote

chainId.description: deBridge chain id (1 ETH, 56 BNB, 137 Polygon, 8453 Base, 42161 Arbitrum, 10 Optimism, 7565164 Solana).

senderAddress.description: Optional. Defaults to the wallet's own address.

tokenIn.description: Input token address (zero address for native).

tokenInAmount.description: Input amount in the token's smallest unit.

tokenOutRecipient.description: Optional. Defaults to the wallet's own address.

description: Confirm and execute a prepared web3_swap quote (signs + broadcasts).
name: web3_swap_execute

quoteId.description: quoteId from a prior web3 quote/call.

description: List the chains deBridge can swap/bridge between.
name: web3_swap_routes

description: Prepare a cross-chain bridge via deBridge DLN. Returns a quote + quoteId to confirm with web3_bridge_execute. Source and destination chains must differ.
name: web3_bridge_quote

dstChainId.description: Destination deBridge chain id (must differ from source).

dstChainOrderAuthorityAddress.description: Optional. Defaults to the wallet's destination address.

dstChainTokenOutRecipient.description: Optional. Defaults to the wallet's own destination address.

srcChainOrderAuthorityAddress.description: Optional. Defaults to the wallet's source address.

srcChainTokenInAmount.description: Source amount in the token's smallest unit.

description: Confirm and execute a prepared web3_bridge quote (signs + broadcasts the source-chain tx).
name: web3_bridge_execute

quoteId.description: quoteId from a prior web3 quote/call.

description: Prepare a generic EVM dapp contract call from pre-encoded calldata. Returns a quoteId to confirm with web3_dapp_execute.
name: web3_dapp_call

evmNetwork.description: Optional EVM network. Defaults to ethereum_mainnet.

valueRaw.description: Optional native value (smallest unit). Defaults to '0'.

description: Confirm and execute a prepared web3_dapp call (signs + broadcasts).
name: web3_dapp_execute

quoteId.description: quoteId from a prior web3 quote/call.

description: Make an HTTP request to an x402-payable API endpoint. Automatically handles the HTTP 402 payment challenge by signing a payment (EVM EIP-3009 on Base/Ethereum, or Solana SPL transfer) with the wallet and retrying with the payment proof. Returns the API response after payment. Use this for x402-enabled APIs like twit.sh. The wallet must be set up with USDC on the target chain.
name: x402_request

headers.description: Optional HTTP headers as key-value pairs

url.description: URL of the x402-payable API endpoint (e.g. https://x402.twit.sh/tweets/by/id?id=1110302988)
